leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize and manage a reactive todo list array using Vue's ref or reactive API
Implement a form handler to capture user input and add new todo items to the list
Bind form inputs to reactive data properties using v-model for two-way data binding
Render dynamic lists of todo items using v-for directives with proper key attributes
Configure click handlers to toggle todo completion status using Vue event binding
Manipulate the todo list array by implementing a function to remove completed items
Integrate conditional rendering with v-if or v-show to display completion feedback
Construct a complete Vue component that combines reactive state, event handlers, and template rendering
